name: A change that was actually checked
description: Plan, then two people working at once, then one copy that holds both, then the tests that were asked for, then the application itself. Nothing here is built into Loadout: every stage is a tile and an arrow, so any of them can be removed.

steps.name: Plan the change
steps.instructions: Say what has to change and split it into work for the two steps after you. Name the behaviour a person should be able to see afterwards.

steps.name: Backend
steps.instructions: Do the part of the plan that lives behind the interface. Add the tests the checks after you name, and run them yourself before you answer.

steps.name: Frontend
steps.instructions: Do the part of the plan a person touches. Add the tests the checks after you name, and run them yourself before you answer.

steps.name: Put the work together
steps.instructions: Both pieces are now in one copy. Make them work together and say what you changed to do it. Do not start new work here.

steps.name: The tests that were asked for
Check the running app
steps.instructions: The application is running from the copy the work landed in. Use it and answer about each requirement below.

criteria.behaviour: Stopping a recording and choosing Later keeps the audio and starts nothing
The next recording starts normally after Later
Restarting the app does not begin the work that was put off
